title: New controls and chat improvements in Copilot for JetBrains
source_used: The GitHub Blog (GitHub changelog, read from the pre-fetched full text)
key_facts: GitHub announced an update to its GitHub Copilot plugin for JetBrains IDEs, the coding editors made by JetBrains.
Enterprise administrators can now use managed settings to choose any available Copilot agent model as the default for new conversations; an explicit model picker choice is still preserved.
Diagnostic intention menus now include a Fix action that opens inline chat and asks Copilot to repair the issue; it uses agent mode when available and ask mode otherwise.
A new MCP setting lets users disable automatic server startup for Copilot and Claude.
The release improves reliability during language server startup, model and provider switching, MCP configuration, customization refreshes, file changes and worktree workflows.
GitHub Copilot has ended support for JetBrains IDE 2025.1; JetBrains IDE 2025.2 or later is now required to use the plugin.
The extracted text lists no version number and no usage figures; the bullet list of chat, account and navigation changes is missing from the extracted text.
